summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for Diagnósticos Clínicos Bienestar web ecosystem. Includes analysis of Chopo.com.mx findings, proposed improvements, detailed technical architecture with Next.js 14, PostgreSQL database schema, SEO implementation with Schema.org (MedicalWebPage, Product, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage), conversion system with cart and tracking, localhost API integration strategy, and complete verification plan with automated tests and manual UAT scenarios.
